1. During the event, the Institute will unlock multiple investigation areas over time.

1. Each investigation requires at least 2 Aniimo. You must designate 1 as the Leader Aniimo before the investigation.
2. After the investigation is complete, you will receive base rewards according to the dispatched Aniimo.

3. Prismana Form and Sparkling Aniimo can sense the residual energy of Legendary Aniimo, which will help speed up the investigation.

When passing through an area with Legendary Aniimo, something special might appear from their energy.
After completing an investigation, you also have a chance to receive 1 Chance Encounter Reward. One of the following rewards will be granted at random:

- Starcryst Essence x1
- Capaseed x5
- Vein Essence x1
